title: Libanius, Progymnasmata (model exercises) / Либаний, Прогимнасмы
author: Libanius (with some pseudepigrapha)
genre: School rhetoric: fables, narrations, chreiai, encomia, ethopoeiae, ekphraseis
size: About 96 pieces (Spanish Wikipedia count); Foerster vol. VIII (several hundred pages, including spuria)
edition: Foerster, Libanii opera VIII (Teubner 1915), public domain; archive.org.
ru_evidence: Russian Wikipedia 'Либаний' lists Russian translations of orations, letters and declamations, but none of the progymnasmata.
en_evidence: C. A. Gibson, Libanius's Progymnasmata (SBL, Writings from the Greco-Roman World 27, 2008), complete (from memory; not re-checked online).
value: Model exercises from the most influential late antique school. Short myths, fables and ekphraseis teach both rhetoric and mythology; foundational for Byzantine education. Ideal for students and teaching.
ai_feasibility: High. Short, self-contained, formulaic pieces suited to batch translation and visible review.
pilot_unit: The narrations (διηγήματα) and fables as a block, estimated about 6,000 words.
